notes: All 31 source and 36 target IDs partitioned exactly once.

בֶּן הַבָּקָר → bullock is read as a rule 30 fusion of the two nouns headed on בָּקָר, with the article taking the written the. The competing reading — בֵּן unrepresented beside a bare בָּקָר → bullock — is named in the unit note as rule 8 requires.

אֲשֶׁר־פֶּתַח is a verbless relative clause with a bare locative accusative rather than a prepositional predicate, so the supplied at joins the noun under rule 33 and the copula joins the predicate under rule 20 — not rule 49, which needs a preposition to head the phrase.
סָבִיב → round about is one compound rendering belonging whole to the adverb, headed on round (rule 40).
The single written shall stays with הִקְרִיבוּ and זָרְקוּ takes the bare sprinkle under rule 22.
